hypotheses: Recognize possible enemy formations from public evidence using an honest source-informed opening prior.
Compare native Flag/Bomb objectives against a count-conditioning control, and correlated teacher worlds against an unweighted uniform control.
analysis: Six exploratory matched contrasts, no multiplicity-adjusted strength claim. Every first policy chooses the same validated own-setup mixture; DOS armies come from unchanged original level3 generation with private seeds independent of visible move seeds. The 20% uniform background approximates procedural deployment and can produce early confident mistakes, documented in the fixed synthetic prediction audit. No model tuning on these games. Independent validation and honest opponents required before promotion.
prerun_revision: Before any saved matches: original procedural setup has asymmetric scans. Rotate both armies 180 degrees between sides to preserve the exact DOS-local formation; old row-only side swap horizontally reflected Red DOS. Policy IDs, recipes, models and source snapshots are unchanged. Superseded preregistration preserved in plan-revisions/v1.
